items.basis: The filter's capture capacity is sized to the campaign-average/median load (0.6 kg/h), but the candidate's own 18-month study shows the load is heavy-tailed with P95 = 3.6 kg/h (and P99 ≥ 3.6 by distribution ordering), i.e. 3.6/0.6 = 6.0× the design point; mass balance forbids the claimed result — at 6× design influent the bed either breaks through (effluent above the design point, so loop solids are NOT held below the bridging threshold) or loads at 6× the design capture rate. bindings.ground: bundle item '18-month suspended-solids load study: the load is HEAVY-TAILED — median 0.6 kg/h but P95 = 3.6 kg/h and P99 = 6.1 kg/h (episodic descaling-line failures dump 6x the median for 2-6 hours, 14 events recorded); average-sized filters blind and bypass during exactly these episodes' (strong overlap: average, heavy, load, median)
